vars.label: Residents with no flood-free road to a hospital (estimate, %)
vars.ref: Estimated by the observatory: the OpenStreetMap road graph (roads.bin) with the roads in FEMA's flood area or under bridges in poor condition closed, and each 2020 Census block tested for an open road to a hospital (cutoff.py)
vars.definition: The share of the area's residents (2020 Census) who would have no open road to any hospital if every road in FEMA's 1% annual chance flood area closed, those whose own street floods included. An estimate and a worst case: the 1% flood everywhere at once and every flooded stretch closed, where a real storm raises only some rivers for a few hours. Expressways and sound bridges stay open. Landslides and fallen trees are not in the model. Vieques and Culebra, with no road to a hospital at all, are left out.
